meta_description: With a network of thousands of manufacturing suppliers and the power of the Xometry Instant Quoting Engine®, Xometry makes it easy to find custom manufacturing options that fit your budget and timeline.
monitored_text: Resources / Blog / Xometry’s AI-Powered Platform Offers Flexible, Transparent Pricing Xometry’s AI-Powered Platform Offers Flexible, Transparent Pricing Written by Tricia Contreras 1 min read Published June 5, 2025 Updated November 20, 2026 With a network of thousands of manufacturing suppliers and the power of the Xometry Instant Quoting Engine®, Xometry makes it easy to find custom manufacturing options that fit your budget and timeline. Flexible Pricing That Fits Your Budget Xometry’s network of thousands of vetted and certified manufacturing suppliers in the United States and worldwide offers you unprecedented manufacturing capacity and flexibility. The Xometry Instant Quoting Engine® matches your project with the ideal suppliers, giving you options when it comes to price and production timelines. Xometry’s extensive supplier network allows you to quickly adjust your sourcing strategy, whether that means shifting to domestic manufacturers or finding cost-effective international alternatives. 30-Day Price Guarantee At Xometry, we understand that price stability is key to maintaining your budget. That's why we guarantee the prices on our quotes for 30 days, allowing you to plan your projects with confidence. Xometry’s transparent pricing also ensures the price you see is the price you’ll pay. When ordering prototypes — originals or models of parts that are intended exclusively for non-commercial purposes — the price shown at checkout includes any applicable tariffs . Shipping is also included, as long as your package is standard size. Freight or oversized packages may require additional shipping charges. Stay Compliant While Keeping Costs Under Control Shifting global trade dynamics can sometimes push companies toward suppliers that may not meet compliance or certification requirements. With Xometry, you don’t have to compromise. Our suppliers meet rigorous quality and regulatory standards , so you get the right parts at the right price without risk. Secure your pricing today — get an instant quote .
